title: Fix Report Viewer blank content by wiring data loading
body:
Report sections (charts, tables, summaries) rendered blank because `ReportView` never passed runtime data to `ReportViewer`. The viewer component destructures `data` from schema but received `undefined`.

## Changes

**Added data loading to `ReportView.tsx`:**
- Added state for `reportRuntimeData` and `dataLoading`
- Implemented effect to fetch data via adapter based on:
  - `report.objectName` → queries object (e.g., 'opportunity')
  - `report.dataSource` → uses explicit datasource config
  - `report.data` → uses inline data directly
- Pass `data` and `loading` to viewerSchema

```tsx
// Before
const viewerSchema = {
  type: 'report-viewer',
  report: reportData,
  showToolbar: true,
  allowExport: true
};

// After
const viewerSchema = {
  type: 'report-viewer',
  report: reportData,
  data: reportRuntimeData,  // ← fetched from adapter
  showToolbar: true,
  allowExport: true,
  loading: dataLoading
};
```

**Added integration tests** covering data loading from objectName, dataSource config, inline data, and error states.

The current `sales_performance_q1` report uses `objectName: 'opportunity'`, so the fix fetches opportunity records via `dataSource.find()` with support for filters, sorting, and pagination (default 100 limit).

<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> ## Bug Description
> 
> The Report Viewer page at `/apps/crm_app/report/sales_performance_q1` displays a blank content area. The toolbar (title, description, Print button) renders correctly, but no report sections (charts, tables, summaries) are visible.
> 
> ![image1](image1)
> 
> ## Root Cause
> 
> The issue is in `apps/console/src/components/ReportView.tsx`. When constructing the `viewerSchema` passed to the `<ReportViewer>` component, the `data` property is **not included**:
> 
> ```tsx
> // apps/console/src/components/ReportView.tsx lines 96-101
> const viewerSchema = {
>     type: 'report-viewer',
>     report: reportData, // The report definition
>     showToolbar: true,
>     allowExport: true
>     // ❌ Missing: data, loading
> };
> ```
> 
> In `packages/plugin-report/src/ReportViewer.tsx`, the component destructures `data` from `schema`:
> ```tsx
> const { report, data, showToolbar, allowExport, allowPrint, loading } = schema;
> ```
> 
> Since `data` is `undefined`:
> - Sections of type `chart` pass `data: data || section.chart.data` → undefined if chart has no inline data
> - Sections of type `table` iterate `data?.map(...)` → renders nothing  
> - Sections of type `summary` call `computeAggregation()` which returns 0 for all values since `data` is undefined
> - The fallback table requires `!report.sections && data && data.length > 0` → fails because `data` is undefined
> 
> Additionally, `ReportView` currently only fetches report **metadata/definitions** via `useMetadata()` (which calls `client.meta.getItems('report')`), but has **no mechanism to fetch the actual report runtime data** based on the report's `dataSource` configuration.
> 
> ## Required Fix
> 
> 1. **In `apps/console/src/components/ReportView.tsx`**:
>    - Add state and effect to load report runtime data. The report definition (from metadata) may contain a `dataSource` config or inline `data` array. The component should:
>      - Check if `reportData.data` exists (inline data) and use it directly
>      - If `reportData.dataSource` is configured, fetch data from the adapter/client using that data source config
>      - Track a `dataLoading` state for the loading indicator
>    - Pass `data` and `loading` to the `viewerSchema`:
>      ```tsx
>      const viewerSchema = {
>          type: 'report-viewer',
>          report: reportData,
>          data: reportRuntimeData,    // ← ADD THIS
>          showToolbar: true,
>          allowExport: true,
>          loading: dataLoading,       // ← ADD THIS
>      };
>      ```
> 
> 2. **Data loading approach**: Use the existing `ObjectStackAdapter` (available via context/hooks in the console app) to query data based on `reportData.dataSource`. If no `dataSource` is defined, fall back to `reportData.data` (inline data from the report definition). The adapter pattern is already established in `apps/console/src/context/MetadataProvider.tsx` via `adapter.getClient()`.
> 
> 3. **Important constraints** (from `@objectstack/spec`):
>    - All changes must conform to the ObjectStack schema protocol
>    - The `ReportViewerSchema` type (in `packages/types/src/reports.ts`) already defines `data?: any[]` and `loading?: boolean` — these just need to be properly populated
>    - The `ReportSchema` type already has `dataSource?: DataSource` and `data?: any[]` fields
> 
> ## Key Files
> 
> - `apps/console/src/components/ReportView.tsx` — Main file to fix (add data loading + pass data to viewerSchema)
> - `packages/plugin-report/src/ReportViewer.tsx` — The ReportViewer component (consumer of the data; likely no changes needed here)
> - `apps/console/src/context/MetadataProvider.tsx` — Shows the adapter/client pattern for API calls
> - `packages/types/src/reports.ts` — Type definitions (ReportViewerSchema, ReportSchema, DataSource)
> 


</details>
